description: This Python source file defines functions for creating various types of charts and visualizations, including line charts, bar charts, 3D surface plots, and more, using plotly and other visualization libraries. It primarily provides chart generation utilities within the openbb_platform project.

classes.name: OpenBBFigure
classes.description: A custom class for creating and updating plotly-based figures, supporting 3D and 2D chart types, with methods for adding traces and layouts.
